title: DRIE etch fail
description: Inductively Coupled Plasma - Deep Reactive Ion Etching (ICP-DRIE) without passivation in the first place leading to highly isotropic etching. When the C4F8 valve was opened, the desired anisotropy has been achieved. However, the process parameters seemed to be not optimized resulting in black silicon.
author: Mgerlt
attribution_md:
DRIE etch fail
Inductively Coupled Plasma - Deep Reactive Ion Etching (ICP-DRIE) without passivation in the first place leading to highly isotropic etching. When the C4F8 valve was opened, the desired anisotropy has been achieved. However, the process parameters seemed to be not optimized resulting in black silicon.
